---
name: Change or bug
about: Define a focused user outcome before implementation
title: ""
---

## Problem and desired behavior

What does the user experience now, and what should happen instead? For a bug, include reproduction steps and platform/version.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concrete, observable outcome

## Scope and data impact

What belongs in this change? Note any saved-data/schema, money, authentication, offline or native dependency impact, or say none.

## Validation

Which focused checks or device/browser evidence will demonstrate the outcome? Note constraints or required configuration without including credentials.
